Measuring the labor-market effects of remote work policy

Specific Aims

Aim 1: Advance measuring the labor-market effects of remote work policy via a policy-focused strategy.

Aim 2: Advance measuring the labor-market effects of remote work policy via a policy-focused strategy.

Background

Rigorous, pre-registered analyses will guard against bias and support reproducibility. Prior work has established a partial understanding, yet key gaps remain. Our preliminary data suggest a tractable path toward measurable improvement. We will assemble a multidisciplinary team with complementary expertise.
